errors.evidence: The purple line with downward-pointing triangle markers begins at an AUC of approximately 79 at N=0, not 92.7.

This description of the purple line is a gross oversimplification. The line starts at AUC ~79, stays low until N=5, then sharply peaks at N=10 with an AUC of ~96, before decreasing again. Simply stating it 'decreases' from an incorrect starting point completely misrepresents its behavior.
The orange line reaches a peak value of approximately 98 at N=10, not 95.2.
The orange line's value at N=20 is approximately 91, not 93.7.
The green line begins at an AUC of approximately 86 at N=0, not 89.4.
The green line increases from its starting point at N=0 (AUC ~86) to its value at N=10 (AUC ~92). The description incorrectly states that it 'decreases'.

errors.text_span: A brown, solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers begins at 84.2 at N=0 and rises to 96.3 at N=10 before declining to 93.7 at N=20.
errors.evidence: There is no brown line with upward-pointing triangle markers in the plot. This entire description is a hallucination.
